legend: A mega-scale project to convert laser light into usable energy for general purposes has begun in the almost infinite experiment area with laser-amplifying glass panes.

The experiment was conducted by placing a laser emitter in one room. After that, the N%%ZSMJ0%% laser receivers were placed in room coordinates (xi,yi)%%ZSMJ1%%; each room has a glass pane on the vertical and horizontal side which is shared between adjacent rooms.
When the laser passes through each vertical glass pane, the laser intensity is increased by A%%ZSMJ2%% units.
When the laser passes through each horizontal glass pane, the laser intensity is increased by B%%ZSMJ3%% units.

Furthermore, the administrator of the project has provided 1 L-shaped reflector to change the trajectory of the laser from horizontal to vertical or vice versa. You want to run Q%%ZSMJ5%% simulation tests to provide the information on the minimum possible laser intensity given the starting point for the laser at coordinates (si,ti)%%ZSMJ6%%; your task is to come up with the resulting laser intensity.
input: The first line contains four integers N,Q,A,B%%ZSMJ7%% (0≤A,B≤109,1≤N,Q≤100000%%ZSMJ8%%) — number of laser receivers, simulations, amplification power of vertical and horizontal glass panes.
Next, N%%ZSMJ9%% lines contain xi,yi,ci%%ZSMJ10%% (0≤xi,yi≤109,0≤ci≤1018%%ZSMJ11%%) — laser receiver coordinates in the Cartesian plane and laser amplification power.
Next, Q%%ZSMJ12%% lines contain si,ti%%ZSMJ13%% (0≤si,ti≤109%%ZSMJ14%%) — laser emitter starting coordinates in the Cartesian plane in each simulation.
output: Print Q%%ZSMJ15%% lines, each line contains a single integer — the minimum possible laser intensity for the simulation.
note: For the first simulation, the L-shaped reflector can be placed on coordinate (3,4); by activating the second receiver, the minimum final laser intensity is 1+2+0=3%%ZSMJ16%%.
For the second simulation, the L-shaped reflector is not used; by activating the second receiver, the minimum final laser intensity is 2+0=2%%ZSMJ17%%.
For the third simulation, the L-shaped reflector can be placed on coordinate (1,5); by activating the fifth receiver, the minimum final laser intensity is 2+1+1+1+2=7%%ZSMJ18%%.
